reason: I already paid an agency that sent me reports and no customers. EUR 5,000 locked in before I even see a first meeting, with no meetings guaranteed, is the same bet I lost last time, and my team has no time to sit through two weeks of approvals and dig out our lost-deal lists.
objection: Three months minimum and 'no number of meetings is guaranteed' means I carry all the risk. By the time I know it doesn't work, I've spent five grand and my people's time.
would_change_my_mind: A paid pilot of one month with no minimum, or part of the fee tied to qualified meetings held, plus two references from SaaS or IT services founders in CEE I can actually call.
